title: Terminal Velocity of a Falling Body with Drag
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: An object of mass m falls from rest under gravity with air resistance proportional to velocity: m dv/dt = mg - kv. Find v(t) and the terminal velocity v_term.

steps.title: Solve via Integrating Factor
steps.mathExpression: \mu(t) = e^{kt/m} \implies \frac{d}{dt}[e^{kt/m} v] = g e^{kt/m} \implies e^{kt/m} v = \frac{mg}{k} e^{kt/m} + C \implies v(t) = \frac{mg}{k} + C e^{-kt/m}

steps.title: Apply v(0) = 0 and Take Limit
steps.explanation: Terminal velocity occurs when drag balances gravity.
